faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Supaul Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Supaul Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Supaul Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Supaul, by in person or registered post, to reach by 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years as per the guideline of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna; post-specific experience in shorthand and typing (Stenographer) or clerical and judicial office work (Clerk). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guideline issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records with no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interaction before the District Level Selection Committee, Supaul, as per guidelines. Applicants for all posts appear before the District Level Selection Committee, Supaul on 15.12.2026 at 4:30 PM for interaction as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. Period of engagement, remuneration and conditions governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Duties to be performed during the prescribed working hours of the Evening Court.
